data.rationale: Verified raw r7 results contain 36 passed business assertions and no failed or infrastructure assertions. Diagnosis has separate evidence and is excluded from business counts. The 88-scenario inventory preserves 46 uncovered scenarios; coverage is not inflated. Critical changed observable paths (pending filtering, active window, 4-role read/new/worker visibility, 5/8s polling, reading/edit/reset, real session expiry, identity/motion and four widths) have independent execution. Existing 4 Web Console ITs and Worker visual evidence corroborate preserved action/security paths and failure/timeout/stale behavior; source inspection supports bounded read projections and original permission/CSRF boundaries. Accept this report for independent review with explicit coverage exceptions, not as full FD completion.
data.exceptions: Grant a scoped exception to the 70% independent requirements coverage threshold (47.73%, 42/88) and unavailable branch coverage for this M1 UI/read projection review. No instrumentation/dependency/full-suite scope is authorized. Worker prior 4 ITs, 29 browser passes plus resolved focus checks, current independent screenshots and static source evidence may support Reviewer assessment but are not added to independent counts. All 46 uncovered scenarios remain uncovered; behavior requirements are not waived. Firefox verification remains user-deferred.
data.residual_risk: Independent gaps include waiting counts/overlap, all event sources/missing associations, full approval/server-role/CSRF/race matrix, hidden/role-change/selection/error recovery and repair denominator; high-volume query cost and Firefox compatibility are unmeasured. Reviewer must identify concrete implementation/evidence defects despite the coverage exception and must not mark all scenarios executed.
